attention_analysis.architecture_interpretation: the article-level ATTN module is a small order-agnostic content scorer (768->128->1 plus token-count prior), with no chunk-position embeddings and no Transformer-style inter-chunk self-attention. Position profiles describe content occurring at positions, not learned ordinal-position awareness, and attention is not treated as a causal explanation
attention_analysis.baseline: for article i, p_ij = content_tokens_ij / sum_j(content_tokens_ij), exactly matching the fixed token-count-weighted MEAN pooling prior
attention_analysis.multi_seed_attention: arithmetic mean of the same article/chunk attention weight across the full predefined seed set before diagnostics; RANDOM has one seed
attention_analysis.overall_reallocation: for each article TV_i = 0.5 * sum_j |a_ij-p_ij|; aggregate across the complete target test set with frozen balance_weight. One-chunk articles therefore contribute TV=0. Report raw and balance-weighted multi-chunk coverage as interpretation context, not as an additional performance metric
attention_analysis.population: target-topic test articles only, for both within-topic and exact cross-topic directions
attention_analysis.position_profile: for each absolute chunk position j, among articles where j exists, compute the frozen-balance-weighted mean log2(a_ij/p_ij), its equivalent geometric-mean multiplier 2^L_j, raw support count, and weighted support mass. Do not collapse positions into another scalar
primary_diagnostics: weighted mean article-level TV distance from token-count prior

bootstrap.interval: 2.5/97.5 percentile; descriptive, not an exhaustive significance-testing program
bootstrap.resampling: paired within target-test (portal, year_month, length_bin) strata; original frozen balance weights travel with sampled rows

model_scope.direct_classical: all six validation-selected family winners; headline = validation-best family winner
model_scope.direct_mlp: selected confirmed config, all five confirmation seeds
model_scope.svd_classical: all six validation-selected family winners; headline = validation-best family winner
model_scope.svd_mlp: selected confirmed config, all five confirmation seeds

multi_seed_reporting.primary_configuration_summary: mean and sample SD of independent seed test metrics; this is the primary architecture/configuration comparison
multi_seed_reporting.secondary_predictor: equal-weight arithmetic mean of per-seed softmax probability vectors; reported separately as the predefined ensemble predictor

qualitative_errors.primary_pair: headline direct classical vs FT-ATTN soft ensemble
qualitative_errors.titles_and_body_excerpts: qualitative metadata only; never classifier input

representation_analysis.joint_topic_global_weighted_pca: fit train+validation+test representations from both topics; use frozen balance weights then normalize each topic to equal total mass; no split-mass normalization
representation_analysis.representative_seed_policy: first predefined confirmation seed, never validation/test-best seed
representation_analysis.source_weighted_pca: fit source-topic train only with frozen balance weights; project both test topics
representation_analysis.vector: 768-D article representation immediately before dropout/final classifier
representation_analysis.visual_method: weighted PCA only; no visual hyperparameter search
representation_analysis.within_topic_global_weighted_pca: for each topic separately, fit train+validation+test frozen representations with that topic's frozen balance weights

target_scoring_weights: Use target split frozen balance_weight for all weighted metrics.
test_unseal_policy: All predictive models/configurations/seed sets and this evaluation/analysis plan are frozen before corpus test text is parsed. Test results never trigger retraining, reselection, calibration, threshold tuning, or ensemble membership changes.
